test_rename_axis_inplace: test DataFrame.rename_axis with inplace=True modifies the frame in place and returns None
test_rename_axis_with_allows_duplicate_l: test DataFrame.rename_axis on a frame with allows_duplicate_labels=False sets the index name
test_rename_axis_raises_on_mapper: test DataFrame.rename_axis raises ValueError when passing a callable or dict as positional mapper argument
test_rename_axis_with_mapper_function: test DataFrame.rename_axis with a function mapper like str.upper to transform index names
test_rename_axis_with_dict: test DataFrame.rename_axis with a dict to rename specific index or column names
test_rename_axis_with_list: test DataFrame.rename_axis with a list to set all index names at once
test_rename_axis_none_mapper: test DataFrame.rename_axis with None mapper to clear index or column names
